title: Justice Department investigating major TV networks over suspending pool coverage of Trump - NBC News
description: The Justice Department said it is investigating five major TV broadcast networks for potentially violating federal antitrust laws after the networks temporarily declined to provide pool coverage of President Donald Trump, a department spokesperson said.
